narrative:
Workforce planning covers about 14,000 employees — more than 80% of them physicians, nurses, therapists, psychologists and care assistants — with a fully loaded personnel cost of about EUR 740M a year.

Nursing follows occupied beds (about 0.61 FTE per occupied bed against a 0.60 target), therapy follows care days and the therapy-minute requirements per indication, and physicians are largely fixed per clinic. Agency staff cover 6.5% of clinical hours against a 5% target, highest in the coastal and Alpine clinics.

Blended attrition is planned at about 12%; first-year leavers among nurses and physiotherapists are the main driver.

signals.title: Nine Paracelsus rehabilitation clinics integrated (2025)
signals.excerpt: Nine rehabilitation clinics acquired from Paracelsus add German inpatient rehab capacity; occupancy ramp-up is the key FY2027 assumption.
